chapter_theme: The attainment of space (ஆகாசப் பேறு): the Lord who is Om, fire and right order within the heart turns the body into space; he stands as earth, cosmos and what lies beyond, and is known as light, cosmic, bodily and undivided, into which the knower's heart opens as open sky. The chapter ends by naming four spaces, outer, inner, in Siva and in the world, the last being the seat of samadhi.
structure_note: The Lord within the heart and across earth and cosmos (2804, 2805); the lights in which he is known (2806 to 2808); the sky-coloured one and the heart become space (2809 to 2811); the four spaces (2812). The grouping is mine.

2804.reading: The one Lord who is Om within the heart, who is fire within it and who is right order within it: within the heart the body itself becomes space.
2804.nuance: Each line opens with உள்ளத்துள் (within the heart), and the last turns from the Lord to the body: உடல் ஆகாயம் ஆமே. It can be read as the body becoming spacious or void in realisation, or as the heart-space (the inner ஆகாசம் of 2812) being where the body is known. நீதி (justice, right order) is an unusual name for the Lord here and I can't fix its sense.

2805.reading: The Lord's nature is to stand as the great earth, as the cosmic sphere and as the ground beyond the sphere; standing as the great earth and bearing it with his feet, the first Lord stands as the rare state.
2805.nuance: குருநிலம் (the guru-ground, or the ground of light, since குரு can mean brightness) names what lies beyond the அண்டம், and I can't fix which. தாங்கிய தாளோன் (he of the feet that bear) joins the cosmic image to the feet the devotee seeks.

2806.reading: The light of the cosmos, with the undivided light and the light of the body, makes a greatness people babble about; hidden in light within the space that has swallowed all, it undid of itself the mark it had taken.
2806.nuance: அண்டம் and பிண்டம் are the cosmos and the body, the large and the small worlds, here each with its light, and அகண்டம் the undivided beyond both. கொண்ட குறி (the mark taken) may be the bodily form, the soul's sense of itself, or the yogi's point of concentration; the subject of குலைத்தது is unclear.

2807.reading: Within the enjoyment of the maidens that yields no fruit is the first supreme flame of light that gives fruit; standing beyond the knowing of Brahma and Mal, the one light becomes the high path.
2807.nuance: பயனறு கன்னியர் போகம் is obscure: it may be the enjoyment of virgin powers (the Lord's shaktis) that produces no birth, or a yogic union without issue, set against the light that does yield fruit. Brahma and Mal failing to find the end of the light is the familiar story of the column of fire.

2808.reading: The undivided light that is knowledge to knowledge, and the three great lights in their inseparable circuit, sink unknowing into the Father's feet; if one stays there without parting, it becomes the great time.
2808.nuance: The three great lights (பேரொளி மூன்று) are traditionally sun, moon and fire, also matched with the channels and centres of the yogic body. பிறிவா வலம் and பெரும் காலம் (great time: long life, or timelessness) are not fixed by the verse.

2809.reading: The sky-coloured one, the shoot of the race of the gods, who sat there wearing a great serpent as his upper cloth, settles into the hue of space, and beyond that becomes space and the one of the colour of fire.
2809.nuance: ஆகாச வண்ணன் (sky-coloured) is usually an epithet of Mal, but ஏகாசம் (upper cloth) of மாசுணம் (great serpent) points to Siva, who wears snakes; the verse may be fusing the two or using the epithet of Siva. The movement is from a coloured form to space itself and then to fire.

2810.reading: When the inner light that gives life to beings and to the world alike comes to join, the girl with the koel's voice frolics and roams, and my heart, taking in sunlight, becomes open space.
2810.nuance: குயில்கொண்ட பேதை (the simple girl who has the koel's voice) may be Shakti, the kundalini, or the poet's own heart as a lovesick girl; the image is from love poetry and I can't fix its referent. வெயில்கொண்டு (taking in the sun) and வெளி (open space) carry the verse's claim that the heart becomes light and space.

2811.reading: Approach him and the Lord does not move away; Nandi, the great Lord, spreads wide even in the atom of the world; if one bows to the space of lightning-light that has drawn near, one may drink nectar.
2811.nuance: அணுகில் அகன்ற may be 'wide even in the atom' or 'far even when near'; both fit the paradox of the first two lines. Drinking nectar after seeing the light is the yogic sequence of the earlier tantras (nectar from the crown).

2812.reading: The outer space is the regions and the worlds; the inner space is the knowing of our First; the space in Siva is the rich flame of light; and the space in the world is the seat of samadhi.
2812.nuance: A scheme of four spaces (ஆகாசம்), each named with துள் (within). The last line, சகத்துளாகாசம் தானம் சமாதியே, is the least clear: தானம் may be 'place, seat' (sthana) or 'giving', and why the space within the world should be samadhi is not explained.

links.note: 2685 ranks the lights of the five elements, with space among them, and gathers all five into one; 2812 takes space alone and grades it from the outer worlds to the knowing within and the light in Siva.
